contentList.content: Seasoned smokers know: when you blend belladonna leaves with mugwort, you don’t get a poison - you get a stimulant. The smoke <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_BELLADONNA">clears the mind and sharpens reflexes</LSTag>.
A plain leather bag, cinched at the top with knotted cord.
A small leather pouch with a drawstring, usually used for storing tobacco.
Not a crumb of tobacco in this pipe.
The pungent aroma of garlic and spices is permanently ground into this stone bowl.

Gilded tools are no luxury for any serious alchemist. While wood is hard to clean, metal often binds to its contents, sometimes with disastrous consequences. A thin layer of gold solves both these problems.
To make tobacco, use a "Mortar and Pestle" and a Pouch containing Mugwort and a second ingredient (you can add several different ingredients).
Even the smell of tobacco makes you <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_OVERDOSE_5">Sick</LSTag>... It's better to take a break from smoking.

Frequent smoking causes the character to feel unwell. He has difficulty concentrating on spells and has Disadvantage on Dexterity Checks.
If you continue to smoke without a long rest, you may experience Headaches.

Frequent smoking caused headaches. In addition to the problems caused by Malaise, сoncentrating on spells is even more difficult and there was also an Disadvantage on Charisma Checks and Attack Rolls.
If you continue to smoke without a long rest, you may experience Nicotine Toxicity.

The character is poisoned by nicotine. He take an additional [1], cannot cast, it's almost impossible to concentrate on spells anymore and has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on all Abilities <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>.

A Malaise requires a <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass">DC</LSTag> [1] Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or the effects of smoking will be removed and concentration spells will cease to work.

A Headaches requires a <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass"> DC</LSTag> [1] Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or the effects of smoking will be removed and concentration spells will cease to work.

A Nicotine Toxicity requires a <LSTag Tooltip="DifficultyClass"> DC</LSTag> [1] Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> or the effects of smoking will be removed and concentration spells will cease to work.

Smocker gains <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag> against Illusion and Enchantment spells. Spell <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against smoker have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag>. Additionally, Initiative is increased by 3.

Regular smoking imposes a penalty on Initiative and Constitution. Prolonged use may result in <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_OVERDOSE_3">Malaise</LSTag>, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_OVERDOSE_4">Headaches</LSTag>, or even <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_OVERDOSE_5">Nicotine Toxicity</LSTag>.
A handy book for jotting down smoking notes.
A pouch of tobacco, but what kind of blend is unclear... Is it worth trying to smoke it?
The pipe is filled with an unknown blend... Is it worth trying to smoke it or is it not worth experimenting?

SMOKER'S NOTES
* for storing notes on smoking.

Standard base ingredient: Mugwort.
Typical pipe load: 3 puffs, effect duration: 30 turns.
Tobacco mix of mugwort and underdark mushrooms improves smokers' <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_UNDERDARKMUSHROOMS">vision in the dark</LSTag>.
An unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort

Smoker gains a [1] to Initiative Rolls, [2] to <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag>, and has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Constitution <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.
Lunar Veil (Belladonna) - Smocker gains Advantage on Saving Throws against Illusion and Enchantment spells. Spell Attack Rolls against smoker have Disadvantage. Additionally, Initiative is increased.

Mage Hunter (Sussur Bloom) - Smoker gains advantage on saving throws against spells of designated level or below, while enemy spell attack rolls are made with disadvantage. In addition, sussure smoke affects creatures and magical automatons.
Mugwort with Swarming Toadstool - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Mugwort with Tongue of Madness - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Wizard’s Beard (Weavemoss) - Smoker's intelligence increases. In addition, he gains Proficiency in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.
Mugwort with White Mushroom - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Tonic (Wispweed ) - Strength and Dexterity of the smoker has increased, and he gains Proficiency in this abilities Saving Throws.

Drained Sussur (Withered Sussur Petal) - Smoker gains advantage on Saving Throws against spells of low level, while enemy spell attack rolls are made with disadvantage. Drained Sussur Smoke no longer exerts an anti‑magic effect on creatures or automatons.
Bitter Musk Nectar (Yellow Musk Creeper Petals) - Smoker has Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned. He also gains Temporary HP, and regains HP each turn if health is less than 50%.

Truffle Hunter (Acorn Truffle) - Smoker gets a bonus to attack and damage rolls with weapons against beasts. In addition, he can communicate with animals and has Proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature and Survival.
Autumn Haze (Autumncrocus) - Smoker is protected against undead, that have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against him.
Healer's Assistant (Balsam) - Smoker regains HP each turn if health is less than 50%.
Graveyard Herb Whispers (Black Oleander) - Smoker gains Temporary HP, has Immune to Necrotic damage, and his wounds do not bleed.
Mugwort with Bluecap - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Intuition blend (Blushcap Mushroom) - Gives the smoker Proficiency in Deception, Persuasion and Survival. Ranged attacks from humanoids have Disadvantage against the smoker.
Assassin's Tobacco (Bonecap) - Unlocks Assassin's sneak attack with additional damage (based on level) and immediately restore your action and bonus action at the start of combat.
Mugwort with Bulbous Fungus - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Mugwort with Bullywug Trumpet - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Whispers of the Dead (Corpse Rose) - Smoker has Immune to Poison damage and can't be Poisoned. And he can Speak with Dead.
Burning Executioner (Daggerroot) - Has Advantage on Dexterity Checks and Saving Throws. When he make an Attack Roll as a reaction, you make it with Advantage.
Mugwort with Dragon Egg Mushroom - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Fairy Escape (Dried Fey Flower) - Smoker can use a reaction to disappear before an attacker's blow, like a dawn fairy in the mist, to make the enemy miss.
Vampire Hunter (Garlic) - Vampire melee attack rolls against smokers are made with disadvantage. In addition, garlic smoke affects vampires.
Mugwort with Glowcap Mushroom - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Mugwort with Goodberry - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Mugwort with Hastening Spores - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.

Celestial Smoke (Ki-Rin Hair) - If the smoker is focused on smoking: increase max HP and regain XP each turn if health is less than 70% with the legendary magic resistance inherent to the Ki-Rin. But it still smells like burnt hair - Charisma reduced with Disadvantage on Checks.
Mugwort with Lemon - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Bogger (Mergrass) - Has Advantage on Deception and Persuasion Checks.

Old Mage’s Puff (Night Orchid) - If the smoker is focused while this tobacco is active, then each turn a Level 1 spell slot is restored, but he takes damage and the effect duration is reduced. If the smoker has less than 20% of his maxHP left, the effect is removed.
Mugwort with Noblestalk - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Mugwort with Onion - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Mugwort with Orange - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Noble Blend (Pale Mint) - Smoker gets Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion, an extra bonus action and can't be Charmed.
Mugwort with Poison Spore - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Picaresque (Rogue's Morsel) - Gain an additional bonus action and has Advantage on Sleight of Hand Checks.
Cursed Blend (Shadowroot Sac) - Smoker gains resistance to the Shadow Curse, has an easier time dealing critical hits, but becomes vulnerable to necrotic damage, and his max HP is reduced.
Mugwort with Timmask Spores - an unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort.
Smoker regains [1] each turn if health is less than 50%.

This blend of Mugwort and Balsam is often used by healers to fumigate patients, but no one prohibits simply smoking it. The healing properties of Balsam alleviate some of the negative effects of smoking and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_BALSAM">help partially restore health</LSTag>.

<LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="Dexterity">Dexterity</LSTag> of the smoker has increased by [1], and he gains <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in this abilities <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>.

Frequent smoking causes the character to feel unwell. He has <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_OVERDOSE_3_REMOVE_STATUSES">difficulty concentrating on spells</LSTag> and has <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.
A tobacco blend of Mugwort and Wispweed relaxes muscles and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_WISPWEED">increases the physical abilities</LSTag> of the smoker.

If the smoker is <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ALCH_ELIXIR_CONCENTRATION">focused</LSTag> on smoking: increase max HP by [1] and regain [2] each turn if health is less than 70% with the legendary magic resistance inherent to the Ki-Rin. But it still smells like burnt hair - Charisma reduced by [3] with <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on her <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.
Tobacco blend of Mugwort and Ki-Rin Hair that, when used correctly, gives <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_KIRINHAIR">a great effect</LSTag>.

Warning
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
* for warnings and harmful blends

Regular smoking imposes a penalty on Initiative and Constitution checks. Prolonged use may result in malaise, persistent headaches, or even nicotine toxicity.
Gain an additional bonus action and has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Sleight of Hand <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.
This blend of Mugwort and Rogue's Morsel gives the smoker <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_ROGUESMORSEL">thief's luck</LSTag>.

Smoker gets a +[1] bonus to attack and damage rolls with weapons against beasts. In addition, he can communicate with animals and has <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in Animal Handling, Nature and Survival.
Blend of Mugwort and Acorn Truffle, that brings the smoker <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_ACORNTRUFFLE">closer to the animal world</LSTag>.
The smoker is protected against undead, that have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against him.

A blend of Mugwort and Autumn Crocus, enveloping the smoker in a wisp of smoke with a subtle golden glow, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_AUTUMNCROCUS">creating a faint barrier against the undead</LSTag>.

The Smoker has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to Poison damage and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">Poisoned</LSTag>. He also gains [1], and regains [2] each turn if health is less than 50%.

Thanks to Mugwort, the corpse poison of the Yellow Musk Creeper Petals is neutralized and this blend confirms that <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_YELLOWMUSKCREEPERPETALS">poison is a medicine</LSTag> when used correctly.
Has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Deception and Persuasion <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag>.

This simple blend of Mugwort and Mergrass strangely grants clarity to the smoker’s thoughts and makes them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_MERGRASS">exceptionally persuasive in conversation</LSTag>.
An unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort and herbs
An unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort and mushrooms
An unremarkable tobacco blend based on Mugwort and food

Have you tried it? The taste is like you licked soil off a grave. But when the necrotic mist surrounds you and your skin starts peeling off, this stuff made of Mugwort and Black Oleander keeps you in the fight. <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_BLACKOLEANDER">It doesn’t heal you</LSTag>. But it keeps you from falling.

Smoker has <LSTag Tooltip="Immune">Immune</LSTag> to Poison damage and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="POISONED">Poisoned</LSTag>. And he can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_SpeakWithDead">Speak with Dead</LSTag> without expending a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag>.

Tobacco blend of Corpse Rose and mugwort whose cold smoke seeps into the smoker’s body and mind, dulling vital currents and drawing them <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_CORPSEROSE">closer to the realm of the dead</LSTag>: it slightly numbs pain, heightens sensitivity to otherworldly whispers, and gives the skin a deathly, grayish hue.

Has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag> on Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Checks</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>. When you make an <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Roll</LSTag> as a <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag>, you make it with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

A pungent tobacco blend of Daggerroot and Mugwort whose searing smoke briefly <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_DAGGERROOT">sharpens reflexes and dead‑eye precision</LSTag>, as if the hangman’s own hand guides your blade.

A rare blend of Mugwort and Dried Fey Flower not only has a very pleasant aroma, but also produces strange smoke that seems <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_DRIEDFEYFLOWER">to tear the veil between worlds</LSTag> in moments of danger.

If the smoker is focused while this tobacco is active, then each turn a Level 1 spell slot is restored, but he takes damage [1] and the effect duration is reduced by [2] turns. If the smoker has less than 20% of his maxHP left, the effect is removed.
At the end effect gives you a Malaise for [3] turns.

A blend of Mugwort and Night Orchid, whose thick purple smoke seems to gather scattered sparks of magic, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_NIGHTORCHID">restoring a lost magical contour</LSTag>. but everything has its price.
Aromatic blend of Mugwort and Pale Mint, which gives the smoker <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_PALEMINT">self-confidence and opens many doors</LSTag>.

The smoker gets <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, and Persuasion, an extra <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="BonusActionPoint">bonus action</LSTag> and can't be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">Charmed</LSTag>.

Any creature within [1] that fails a <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> is given <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_SUSSURBLOOM_AURA_CHAR_STATUS">Lump in the throat</LSTag>.

Any magically animated automaton within [1] that fails a <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> is given <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_SUSSURBLOOM_AURA_ANIMATED_STATUS">Fragile magical bonds</LSTag>.

Sussure smoke weakens magical bonds and causes a decrease in <LSTag Tooltip="Constitution">Constitution</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="Strength">Strength</LSTag> and <LSTag Tooltip="ArmourClass">Armour Class</LSTag> by [1].
Though its full antimagical force is lost, this intense blend of Mugwort and Sussur Bloom still <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_SUSSURBLOOM">tips the scales</LSTag> for mage hunters.
The smoker's intelligence increases by [1], but not more than [2]. In addition, he gains <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, and Religion.

In addition, enemy spell <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag> against the smoker are made with <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">Advantage</LSTag>.

An incredibly bitter blend of Mugwort and Weavemoss will appeal to no one — except those who seek <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_WEAVEMOSS">to comprehend the Weave</LSTag>. This is not tobacco for pleasure, but a tool — harsh, impartial, demanding the willingness to accept knowledge along with its burden.

Thick, acrid smoke with a nauseating aroma of Shadowroot Sac and Mugwort - this painful blend <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_SHADOWROOTSAC">allows one to endure</LSTag> poisonous fumes, anomalous magic, and other horrors of the Cursed Lands.

A potent blend of Mugwort and Bonecap, when combined and smoked, enriches each other’s properties, <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_BONECAP">awakening the darkest killer instincts</LSTag> within the smoker.
Infused with Blushcap Mushroom, this tobacco blend <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_BLUSHCAPMUSHROOM">powerfully enhances vigilance and intuitive perception</LSTag>.

Gives the smoker <LSTag Tooltip="Proficiency">Proficiency</LSTag> in Deception, Persuasion and Survival. Ranged attacks from humanoids have <LSTag Tooltip="Disadvantage">Disadvantage</LSTag> against the smoker.

Halsin's partner is happy to smoke his pipe. +1 to all <LSTag Tooltip="AttackRoll">Attack Rolls</LSTag>, <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throws</LSTag>, and most <LSTag Tooltip="AbilityCheck">Ability Checks</LSTag>.

The blend of mugwort and garlic produces acrid smoke that causes <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="KTP_MUGWORT_GARLIC">tearing and burns the mucous membranes</LSTag> of vampires. But the pungent stench of burnt garlic makes any conversation difficult.
Though the mortar and pestle both look clean, the old wood is infused with an acrid smell.
